name: rolling30-native-loading-repro
comparison: independent stock; every regenerated traversal and 120 continuation ticks
scope: Test whether the verified native single-thread loading option stabilizes independent startup; normal rendering, identical option on candidate and stock, 30 rolling cycles, 1 GiB; not qualification.
